name: action-platform
description: Scaffold, deploy and operate projects from templates.

interface.longDescription: Scaffold, deploy and operate projects from your AI client — init a service from production-grade templates, overlay a cloud, add a database, release and deploy, all through platform.toml. Projects stay cloud-agnostic; deploy overlays and services are added on top. Release and deploy are dry runs until you confirm.
defaultPrompt: Create a FastAPI service called orders deployed on AWS Lambda.
Add a Postgres database to this project.
What would the next release look like?
